title: The Kerala Local Self Government Common Service Act, 2022
full_text: The Kerala Local Self Government Common Service Act, 2022 2022-ലെ കേരള തദ്ദേശ സ്വയംഭരണ പൊതുസര്‍വ്വീസ് ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202215 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 2022-09-23 Act Year: 2022 Short Title: The Kerala Local Self Government Common Service Act, 2022 Hindi Title: 2022-ലെ കേരള തദ്ദേശ സ്വയംഭരണ പൊതുസര്‍വ്വീസ് ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to constitute a Local Self Government Common Service by integrating the services under Panchayat, Municipality, Local Self Government Department (Planning) and the services of Rural Development and Local Self government Engineering Division, in the State of Kerala.
